requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the provider scoring engine from evaluate_care_facade when provider detail data is requested.
The system must pass all required provider quality measures (≥3) from the facade to the scoring engine.
The system must receive a deterministic composite score from the scoring engine and attach it to the provider detail response.
The system must preserve all existing provider detail fields unchanged when adding the composite score to the response.
The system must include the composite score in a consistent field structure defined by the provider score schema.
The system must ensure that identical provider inputs through the facade produce identical composite scores.
The system must not call the scoring engine if fewer than 3 valid quality measures are available.
The system must return a null or explicitly marked unavailable score field when scoring is skipped due to insufficient measures.
The system must handle scoring engine execution errors by returning provider details without a score and without failing the entire response.
The system must log scoring engine invocation success and failure events within the facade layer.
The system must ensure that the facade integration does not introduce additional latency exceeding defined service thresholds for provider detail responses.
The system must maintain backward compatibility for consumers that do not yet use the composite score field.
